managementTone.evidenceNotes: CEO Sanjay Mehrotra and CFO Mark Murphy projected exceptional confidence throughout the Q3 FY2026 call, underpinned by 100% contracted HBM3e capacity through calendar 2026, over 80% visibility into 2027 allocations, and accelerating 60TB+ QLC enterprise SSD adoption. Management maintained disciplined capex rhetoric, emphasizing that incremental wafer capacity is strictly dedicated to meeting non-cancellable AI customer advance commitments.

topTopics.topic: HBM3e 12-High Ramp Velocity & NVIDIA Allocation Share
topTopics.managementResponse: Sanjay Mehrotra confirmed that Micron's 36GB 12-high HBM3e stack is shipping in volume to NVIDIA for Blackwell GB200 architectures, outperforming rival products by 30% in power efficiency, and on track to achieve ~25% HBM market share by CY2027.

topTopics.topic: CapEx Expansion vs Long-Term Free Cash Flow Generation
topTopics.managementResponse: Mark Murphy detailed that FY2026 capex of $8.5B-$9.0B is heavily weighted toward cleanroom shell construction in Boise and advanced packaging tooling, with >70% of outlays directly tied to firm customer commitments and subsidized by CHIPS Act direct grants.

Management pointed out that the memory market is structurally undersupplied due to HBM wafer consumption ratios (3:1 vs DDR5). Even as secondary suppliers qualify, tight industry wafer capacity will prevent margin erosion through FY2027.

topTopics.topic: PC and Smartphone On-Device AI Content Elasticity
topTopics.managementResponse: Micron noted that while unit device volumes remain moderate (+2-3%), DRAM content per device is inflecting by 40-70% as AI smartphones standardize on 16GB-24GB LPDDR5X, driving strong segment profitability.

keyQuotes.speaker: Sanjay Mehrotra
keyQuotes.context: Opening remarks on HBM market traction and multi-year customer commitments.
keyQuotes.quote: Our HBM capacity is completely sold out through calendar 2026, and our calendar 2027 availability is already overwhelmingly committed under firm customer agreements. Micron is entering the AI era with the most competitive product portfolio and power efficiency in our company's history.

keyQuotes.speaker: Mark Murphy
keyQuotes.context: Discussion of capital allocation, CHIPS Act incentives, and margin outlook during financial review.
keyQuotes.quote: We generated record operating cash flow in the third quarter and expanded clean operating margins to 36%. As we transition our 1-beta DRAM and 232-layer NAND bits to high-value AI workloads, we anticipate continued gross margin expansion into the low-to-mid 40s in the fourth quarter.

keyQuotes.speaker: Sanjay Mehrotra
keyQuotes.context: Response to analyst questions regarding enterprise SSD displacement of hard drives.
keyQuotes.quote: In enterprise storage, AI data pipelines and inference caching are driving an unprecedented shift from HDDs to high-capacity QLC SSDs. Micron's 60TB+ D5 enterprise SSDs are setting the industry benchmark for throughput per watt.
